name: NERF ISLAND
desc:
New Content Update - Motoblitz Arena!
In the Motoblitz Arena, you and up to 3 other players will defend your base tower from endless waves of invading forces.

***

Welcome to NERF ISLAND, an action-packed, immersive experience officially developed by Nerf and Metaverse Team. 

Explore and unleash your blasting skills with the brand new Viper Strike blaster, collect Nerf-inspired items, and challenge yourself in the Viper Strike Pit!

🔫 Blast targets to earn tickets
🧢 Unlock Nerf-inspired items
💥 Conquer the Viper Strike Pit obstacle course

We’re not done yet! Be on the lookout for updates coming soon!

NOVEMBER – Nerf Sports update

Redeem exclusive codes included with every Nerf Roblox blaster (sold separately) to get a virtual version in corresponding experiences: roblox.com/nerf
